notes_for_editor: Only two readable sources, and both are thin. The 1979 date and the October 2025 check both come from the same Firelookout.ca entry, which is written by a visitor. The Facebook post's readable text is its title alone. A comment on that post, not quoted here because its text is not in the readable page text, says the tower was dismantled in September 1979 by a crew flown in by helicopter, and that the steel should still be on site unless it was removed later. A human could check this against the Ontario Forest Fire Report Files or Thunder Bay archives. Build date, design, height, staffing and fire history were not found in two searches or the cache, so the story leaves them out. The record's coordinates (48.82678, -86.38468) match Firelookout.ca; the Canadian Geographical Names Database lists Bamoos Mountain at about 48.8269, -86.3847 (not cited, because it was not read as a page).
